name: UQ Indigenous Commonwealth Scholarships (UQ-ICS)
summary: Per-semester education costs and accommodation scholarships for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students in any UQ coursework program.
key: UQ-ICECS: $1,500 each semester, UQ-ICAS $2,500 each semester.
who: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
Enrolled in any coursework program in the semester of the award.
Not getting assistance from another Commonwealth source for the same purpose.
how: Apply using the online application form. One application covers all scholarships in the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Education Scholarship scheme.
catches: Applications opened 17 August 2026 and close 26 February 2027.
